<p style="padding-top:15px">'''Free Fire World Series''' ('''FFWS''' in short) is a [[Global_Events|Global]] tournament held biannually by [[Garena]].</p>

==About==
* Garena announced teams from the CIS region will not participate in FFWS.<ref name="cisout">{{cite web|url=https://vk.com/wall-196368592_118380 |title=Игроки не примут участие в чемпионате Free Fire World Series. |date=2022-10-11 |publisher=Garena |language={{Flag|ru}}Russian}}</ref> Thus, the two teams from CIS; {{Team|Esports Orig}} and {{Team|Virtus.pro}} lost their spots.

===Format===
* '''Play-ins:''''' November 25th, 2022
** 9 teams.
** 8 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 4}} advance to the ''Finals''.
<div style="margin-top:1em"></div>
* '''Finals:''''' November 26th, 2022
** 12 teams:
*** {{Bgcolortext|stayup|8 teams}} directly invited
*** {{Bgcolortext|stayup|Top 4 teams}} from Play-ins
** 8 matches.
<br/>
{{Points12|showtb=true}}
